description: This file provides utility functions related to fetch operations in a browser testing environment. It defines types for fetch-like functions, checks their usability, and provides a function to obtain a fetch function that uses either a custom require or global fetch, with cache busting for shared workers.

methods.name: function isUsableFetch(value: unknown): value is FetchLike { isUsableFetch
methods.description: Checks if a given value is a fetch-like function that is usable, i.e., a function and not a mock.

methods.name: export function getBrowserTestFetch(): BrowserTestFetch { getBrowserTestFetch
methods.description: Returns a fetch function suitable for testing, attempting to use 'undici' with cache busting, or falling back to global fetch.

ctags.name: BrowserTestFetch
ctags.pattern: /^export type BrowserTestFetch = (input: string | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;$/

ctags.name: FetchLike
ctags.pattern: /^type FetchLike = ((input: string | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>) & {$/

ctags.name: fetch
ctags.pattern: /^  const { fetch } = require("undici") as typeof import("undici");$/

ctags.name: vitest
ctags.pattern: /^  const vitest = (globalThis as { vi?: { doUnmock?: (id: string) => void } }).vi;$/
